Salesforce Consulting for Nonprofits

Clear Concise Consulting provides Salesforce consulting for nonprofits, including NPSP implementation, Agentforce Nonprofit (formerly Nonprofit Cloud) migration, donor data management, and grants tracking. CCC holds the Nonprofit Cloud Consultant certification and has 14 years of nonprofit Salesforce experience.

Nonprofits lose up to 30% of potential revenue due to bad data. Duplicate contacts split donation histories. Obsolete emails compromise campaigns. Program management lives in spreadsheets while your CRM collects dust.

Your mission deserves better.

NPSP or Nonprofit Cloud? The Decision That Shapes Everything

If you're researching Salesforce for your nonprofit, you've hit the fork in the road: stick with the Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP) that over 56,000 organizations trust, or migrate to the newer Nonprofit Cloud (NPC) that Salesforce is pushing as the future.

Here's what nobody tells you upfront: there is no automatic upgrade path. Moving from NPSP to Nonprofit Cloud requires a full reimplementation. That means months of data migration, potential downtime, and staff retraining.

This isn't a software update. It's a strategic decision that affects your budget, your team, and your ability to serve your mission.

The Hidden Cost Nobody Mentions

Those "10 free licenses" are just the beginning. Here's what our nonprofit clients typically discover:

 

Implementation Costs

 

$7,000 to $30,000 Covering consulting, data migration, integrations, and configuration.

 

Technical Expertise Gap

 

Most nonprofits lack in-house Salesforce expertise. That means ongoing consultant fees for changes, fixes, and training.

 

Data Cleanup Before Go-Live

 

Migrating dirty data just moves problems to a new system. Plan for deduplication, standardization, and validation work.

 

Third-Party Apps

 

Payment processing, event registration, volunteer management, email marketing: none of these are native to Salesforce. Budget for AppExchange solutions.

 

Staff Time and Training

 

Your team will spend weeks learning the new system. Factor in productivity loss during the transition.

 

Problems We Solve Every Day

  • When the same donor appears twice (or five times), their giving history fragments. Annual reports undercount loyal supporters. Acknowledgment letters go to wrong addresses. We implement matching rules, merge strategies, and ongoing governance to consolidate your records and keep them clean.

  • Your development team uses one system, events uses another, and program staff manage participants in spreadsheets. We unify these into a single source of truth so every team sees the complete constituent picture.

  • When your Salesforce donation totals don't match your accounting system, nobody trusts either one. We configure proper opportunity stages, payment mappings, and reconciliation processes so your numbers align.

  • Neither NPSP nor Nonprofit Cloud includes native payment processing. We integrate third-party solutions like Stripe, PosiPay, or Classy so you can accept donations without leaving Salesforce.

  • Some consultants enable Person Accounts for nonprofits without understanding the consequences. It's a one-way decision that breaks NPSP compatibility. We help you choose the right data model from the start.

  • Managing monthly donors shouldn't require spreadsheets. We configure Enhanced Recurring Donations, payment processor integrations, and automated receipting so sustainer programs run themselves.

    Role-based training for fundraisers, program staff, and administrators. Live workshops, recorded sessions, and documentation your team will actually use.

Understanding the Power of Us Program

Eligible organizations may select 10 donated Agentforce Nonprofit Enterprise licenses or 10 Sales and Service Enterprise licenses through Salesforce's Power of Us Program. NPSP is a managed-package suite that can be installed on the Sales and Service option; it is not a license type.

What's included:

  • 10 user licenses

  • Standard data storage allocation

  • Access to the Trailblazer Community for Nonprofits

What's not included:

  • Implementation services

  • Data migration

  • Training

  • Third-party apps

  • Additional storage or licenses beyond 10

Many organizations assume "free" means zero cost. In practice, you'll need implementation support, data cleanup, and potentially additional tools. Budget accordingly.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • It depends on your organization's size, technical capacity, and growth plans. NPSP remains fully supported and works well for small to mid-sized nonprofits. Nonprofit Cloud offers more advanced features but requires more technical expertise and budget. We recommend a discovery session to assess your specific situation before making this decision.

  • For a basic implementation with data migration, 6-10 weeks. Complex implementations with multiple integrations, custom automation, and large data volumes may take 12-16 weeks. We provide realistic timelines during discovery, not sales pitches.

  • We extract data from your existing system, clean and transform it to match Salesforce's data model, and load it in the correct sequence. Relationships between records (like contacts and donations) are preserved. We run parallel testing to validate accuracy before go-live.

  • Yes. While Clear Concise Consulting is based in Manhattan, we work with nonprofits across the United States. Most implementation work happens remotely, with optional on-site training sessions.

  • This is common. We offer health checks to assess your current configuration, identify problems, and create a remediation roadmap. Sometimes a few targeted fixes dramatically improve usability. Other times, a more significant reconfiguration makes sense.

  • Yes. We build integrations with Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Pardot, Marketing Cloud, and other platforms. The right integration depends on your email volume, segmentation needs, and budget.

  • We offer retainer-based support for organizations needing regular assistance, as well as ad-hoc consulting for occasional needs. All implementations include documentation and training so your team can handle day-to-day administration independently.

  • We integrate third-party payment solutions like Stripe, Classy, or PosiPay. The right choice depends on your donation page needs, transaction volume, and existing infrastructure. We configure the integration so payments flow into Salesforce as donations automatically.

  • Household Accounts (used by NPSP) create an Account record for each household with related Contact records for individuals. Person Accounts (used by Nonprofit Cloud) combine Account and Contact into a single record per individual. This is a fundamental architecture choice that affects how you track relationships, households, and organizational affiliations.

  • Our rates reflect the specialized expertise required for nonprofit implementations. We work with organizations to scope projects appropriately for their budgets, whether that means a phased approach or focusing on highest-impact features first.
